targetText: behind the epistemological scholasticism of empirio-criticism one must not fail to see the struggle of parties in philosophy, a struggle which in the last analysis reflects the tendencies and ideology of the antagonistic classes in modern society.
explanation: Lenin demonstrates the class partisan nature of philosophy: epistemological theories are never socially neutral, but directly or indirectly serve the ideological defense of the ruling class (idealism and agnosticism) or the revolutionary liberation of the proletariat (materialism).
